title: Porter & Charles — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Porter & Charles.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Value Appliances." Specialty tier. Porter & Charles offers value appliances distributed by Tasco in Canada — cooktops, wall ovens, and range hoods at entry-to-mid pricing.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Canadian dealers needing value options. Tasco dealer network.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Porter & Charles:

• Tasco distribution in Canada

• Value pricing for basic needs

• Cooktops, ovens, and hoods

• Canadian dealer availability

• Entry-level built-in options
